texts: Marra Tallowhand keeps a detailed log every night.
Council members often consult Marra Tallowhand's logs.

fields.sentence: Marra Tallowhand keeps a detailed log every night.

review.notes: Multi-word name gets one opaque symbol plus its Name and no invented kind atom; 'detailed' is correctly a distributing-free descriptive Member on the singular witness rather than a fused compound, and 'every night' takes the named-slot form (Time night + Every 1 day) with no status atom, as the habitual rule requires. The narrow-scope indefinite ('a detailed log' shared across nights rather than one per night) is the reading the sections dictate, and scope alternations are explicitly not a multiple-reading trigger.

review.notes: Frequency-adverb generic routed as a distributing rule at strength 0.8 with the mandatory 'often' QuantifierPhrase companion, and the compound genus, possessed-plural group witness, multi-word Name and Theme role all follow doctrine. Fusing capitalized 'Council members' into council_member is the compound-concepts route rather than the proper-noun-premodifier route, which is correct only because a bare capitalized class word is a common noun by default.
